# Startup + Messages-feed profile, recorded on the owner's Samsung A30s (Android 16) from the 3.0.3 release build:
# cold starts, the perf.sh feed fling, every tab and a message detail; dumped with
# `adb shell cmd package dump-profiles --dump-classes-and-methods app.phonebridge` and mapped back to source names with
# qa/tools/deobf_profile.py + R8's mapping.txt (no Macrobenchmark: the device is not rooted, no emulator here).
# material3 1.5.0-beta02, navigation and graphics-shapes ship almost no profile of their own: these rules cover them.
# Regenerate after large UI changes. The wildcard keeps all app code hot even where the recording missed it.
